name: Chandler Wick
title: The Chandlery
examine: Yes, that is his real name, and no, he did not pick the trade for it — the trade picked him, he'll tell you, grinning like a lit taper. Every shrine candle passed through his hands first.
lines: The shrine's wicks are dipped here. Sella blesses the flame; somebody has to make the part that burns.
Tallow for the Vale, beeswax for the Row, and one box a month that goes down the Undercroft stair and doesn't come back. I don't ask. The coin's good.
A candle is a clock you can read in the dark. People forget that. I sell a lot of clocks.
